question: Find all British drivers born after 1980 who achieved a rank of 2 in any race. Calculate their current age and show the average points they scored in the Turkish Grand Prix throughout their career.

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    d.XCL_038,
    d.XCL_039,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040)) AS current_age,
    AVG(ds.XCL_030) AS avg_turkish_gp_points
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN driverStandings AS ds
    ON d.XCL_034 = ds.XCL_029
INNER JOIN races AS r
    ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'British'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) > '1980'
  AND r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM driverStandings AS ds2
      WHERE ds2.XCL_029 = d.XCL_034
        AND ds2.XCL_031 = 2
  )
GROUP BY
    d.XCL_034,
    d.XCL_038,
    d.XCL_039,
    d.XCL_040

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    d.XCL_038,
    d.XCL_039,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040)) AS current_age,
    AVG(ds.XCL_030) AS avg_turkish_gp_points
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN driverStandings AS ds
    ON d.XCL_034 = ds.XCL_029
INNER JOIN races AS r
    ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'British'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) > '1980'
  AND r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM driverStandings AS ds2
      WHERE ds2.XCL_029 = d.XCL_034
        AND ds2.XCL_031 = 2
  )
GROUP BY
    d.XCL_034,
    d.XCL_038,
    d.XCL_039,
    d.XCL_040

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
SELECT
    d.XCL_038,
    d.XCL_039,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040)) AS current_age,
    AVG(ds.XCL_030) AS avg_turkish_gp_points
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN driverStandings AS ds
    ON d.XCL_034 = ds.XCL_029
INNER JOIN races AS r
    ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'British'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) > '1980'
  AND r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM driverStandings AS ds2
      WHERE ds2.XCL_029 = d.XCL_034
        AND ds2.XCL_031 = 2
  )
GROUP BY
    d.XCL_034,
    d.XCL_038,
    d.XCL_039,
    d.XCL_040

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039,
       (STRFTIME('%Y','now') - STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040)) AS current_age,
       AVG(ds.XCL_030) AS avg_turkish_gp_points
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.XCL_034 = ds.XCL_029
INNER JOIN races r ON ds.XCL_028 = r.XCL_065
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'British'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) > '1980'
  AND r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM driverStandings ds2
    WHERE ds2.XCL_029 = d.XCL_034 AND ds2.XCL_031 = 2
  )
GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_040

    AVG(res.XCL_082) AS average_points_turkey

    drivers d

    results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075

    AND res.XCL_077 = 2
    AND r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
